reader_summary.headline: David is a General Partner at Andreessen Horowitz, where he leads the firm’s growth investing business.
reader_summary.overview: David is a General Partner at Andreessen Horowitz, where he leads the firm’s growth investing business. His team has backed many of the defining companies of this era – including Databricks, Figma, Stripe, SpaceX, Anduril. This conversation is a detailed look at how David built and runs the a16z growth practice.

key_points.text: His team has backed many of the defining companies of this era – including Databricks, Figma, Stripe, SpaceX, Anduril.
He shares how he recruits and builds his team a “Yankees-level” culture, how his team makes investment decisions without traditional committees.
Much of our conversation centers on AI and how his team is investing across the stack, from foundational models to applications.
